accepted: All five production avatars now articulate both standard MetaHuman hand rigs rather than preserving flat imported finger reference poses.
Visible-paddle actions apply a deterministic firm curl across thumb, four metacarpals and all finger segments; no-paddle rescue or swim states retain a light relaxed curl.

The change is visual-only and leaves crew mass, water, raft, D3/D4 contact, collision, rescue, progression and command pose authority unchanged.
The UE 5.8 editor build, focused Python contracts and exact M5 production suite are green.
rejected_or_open: The coarse production hand mesh, generic curl profile and residual hand-to-shaft spacing remain visibly synthetic and prevent photoreal character approval.
The fingers do not yet use per-action grasp targets, inverse kinematics, grip sockets, contact constraints or a motion-captured paddle stroke.
The broad seated posture, shoulder/elbow deformation and torso reaction remain procedural and do not yet read as trained synchronized rafting technique.
Raft, rock, broad water, foam/aerosol, shoreline, terrain, foliage and lighting remain below the requested photoreal bar.
No named guide or art reviewer has approved grip safety, hand placement, stroke biomechanics or capture.
The captures are not approved for marketing, store, trailer, press-kit or release-media use.
